summary: On July 25, 2026 Hacktron AI researchers, using Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 to build the exploit, compromised the Discourse server behind OpenAI's community forum with a crafted HEIC image that triggered a libheif memory bug (fixed upstream months earlier without a CVE). From the forum server they used a second flaw to take over ChatGPT and Codex accounts, including an OpenAI employee's account whose Codex was connected to OpenAI's GitHub organization, giving them a way to read and suggest changes to OpenAI's private code. They reported it through OpenAI's bug bounty; Discourse shipped a fix on July 27 and OpenAI paid a $6,500 award. OpenAI described the testing as out of scope.
